application.description: Management application for requests to the Ministry of Mines and Geology (demo, fictitious data).

connexion.presentation: Submit your mining document requests, pay online and track their progress.
connexion.aide: You will be redirected to the secure sign-in page, then brought back here.
connexion.demo: Demonstration platform: all data is fictitious.

connexion.conseil: Please try again. If the problem persists, contact the platform administrator.

indisponible.titre: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable.
indisponible.conseil: Please try again in a few minutes.

demandes.aide: Submit an application online: choose the document, attach your files, then pay the fees.

dossiers.vide: No files to process at the moment.
dossiers.aide: Requests submitted by applicants will appear here.

compteNonActive.titre: Your account is not yet activated on e-mine.
compteNonActive.conseil: Contact the platform administrator to link it to your profile.

indisponible.conseil: Please try again in a few minutes. Your data is not lost.

document.superficieAide: Positive number, at most two decimals (example: 125.50).

enregistrement.reessayer: Please try again shortly. Your entries are kept on this page.

erreurs.DEM-003: This application has already been submitted.
erreurs.DEM-005: This document is no longer offered.
erreurs.VAL-001: Some information needs to be corrected.
erreurs.PERM-001: Your profile does not allow submitting an application.
erreurs.autre: The draft could not be saved.

enregistrement.sessionExpiree: Your entries are kept on this device. Sign in again to save them: you will come back to this page.

erreurs.superficieInvalide: Enter a positive number with at most two decimals.

nonAutorise.titre: Your profile does not allow submitting an application.

pieces.consigne: One PDF, JPG or PNG file of up to 10 MB per document. It is sent as soon as you choose it or drop it on the document’s row.

erreurs.chargement: The documents could not be loaded. Reload the page.
erreurs.DOC-001: Format not accepted: PDF, JPG or PNG only.
erreurs.DEM-003: The application has already been submitted: its documents can no longer change.
erreurs.AUTH-001: Your session has expired: please sign in again.
erreurs.autre: The document could not be processed. Please try again.

pieces.deposerIci: Drop the file for this document

depot.manquantesTitre: Mandatory documents to attach before submitting:
depot.manquantes: Add them in the Attachments section. The front desk officer will then check their content.
depot.declaration: I solemnly declare that the information provided is accurate and that the attached documents are authentic.
depot.impossible: The application cannot be submitted yet.

restauration.texte: Your latest changes, kept on this device, have been restored. They will be saved at the next step.

demande.descriptionNouvelle: Four steps: applicant, document, attachments, summary. Your entries are saved as you go.

detail.confirmationSuite: Keep this number: it identifies your file with the Ministry.

etape.agentVerifier: The application fee has been paid. Check the attached documents, then declare the application admissible or inadmissible.
etape.agentAttenteComplement: Additional information was requested: the application is waiting for the applicant's documents.
etape.agentInstruire: Review the application and give your opinion.
etape.agentDecision: Opinion given: the signatory's decision is expected.
etape.agentAttenteDroits: Approval given: the application awaits payment of the duties by the applicant.
etape.agentDelivrer: The application is ready for issuance: the document can be prepared, signed and issued.
etape.demandeurPayerFrais: Pay the application fee ({montant}) so that the one-stop shop officer can review your application.
etape.demandeurCompleter: Additional information is requested: attach the documents indicated by the front desk officer.
etape.demandeurInstruction: Your application is being reviewed by the Ministry's services.
etape.demandeurPayerDroits: A favourable decision was issued: pay the duties ({droits}) to obtain your document.
etape.demandeurDelivrance: Your application is ready for issuance: your document is being prepared.
etape.demandeurDelivree: Your document has been issued: view it, download it or have it checked with its QR code.
etape.demandeurRejetee: Your application has been rejected. The reason is shown above.
etape.agentFraisAttendus: The application fee has not been paid yet: you can declare the application admissible once it is paid. If the file cannot succeed, declare it inadmissible and give the reason.
etape.demandeurAttenteGuichet: Application fee paid. The one-stop shop officer is now reviewing your file; you will be informed of the decision.
etape.agentAttenteDecision: Admissible application: the signatory’s decision ({signataire}) is awaited.
etape.signataireDecider: This application is admissible and you are its signatory. Review the file and the attached documents below, then give your decision.
etape.signataireDelivrer: The duties are paid: you can sign and issue the document. Check the file one last time.

paiements.legende: Payments for this application, most recent first

mesDemandes.description: Follow the progress of each application. A draft opens in the form.

avertissement.titre: Your session is about to expire
avertissement.texte: Without any action, you will be signed out in 2 minutes to protect your data. Your current entries are kept.

expiree.texte: Sign in again to continue. Your current entries are kept on this device and you will come back to this page.

erreur.titre: This page could not be displayed.
erreur.description: An unexpected error occurred. Your data is not lost.

visualiseur.formatNonAffichable: This format cannot be displayed here. Use the Download button.

paiement.rienTitre: No payment is expected for this application
paiement.rienTexte: The payment has already been made, or no payment is required at this stage. The application tracking shows the next step.
paiement.montantBareme: Amount set by the Ministry’s official scale. It cannot be changed.
paiement.enCoursTitre: A payment is already in progress ({reference})
paiement.enCoursTexte: If you start the payment again, the previous one will be cancelled and a new reference will be created.

choix.obligatoire: Choose a payment method to continue.

TRESORPAY.aide: Secure online payment by the Public Treasury. Immediate confirmation and downloadable receipt.

VIREMENT.aide: Transfer from your bank with the payment reference. Coming soon on e-mine.

choix.creeSuite: You will be taken to TrésorPay to complete it.

erreurs.PAY-001: This payment has already been made
erreurs.PAY-007: No payment is expected at this stage
erreurs.autre: The payment could not be prepared
erreurs.reessayer: Please try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact the one-stop shop.

choix.redirection: You will be taken to the secure TrésorPay page.
choix.tentatives: {nombre, plural, one {You have # attempt left today.} other {You have # attempts left today.}}
choix.tentativesEpuisees: You have made 3 online payment attempts today. You can try again tomorrow from midnight.
choix.indisponibleTexte: No amount has been charged and no attempt has been counted. Please try again in a few minutes.

retour.tentativesRestantes: {nombre, plural, one {You have # attempt left today.} other {You have # attempts left today.}}
retour.tentativesEpuisees: You have reached 3 attempts today: you can try again tomorrow.

attente.longueTexte: TrésorPay has not confirmed your payment yet. Do not pay a second time: your application will be updated as soon as the confirmation arrives.

paye.texte: Thank you. Your payment has been received by the Public Treasury and your receipt is ready. The one-stop shop officer can now review your application.

a_verifier.texte: The amount received does not match the expected amount. The tax department is checking it; you do not need to do anything for now.

echoue.texte: Your bank declined the payment. No amount has been charged.

annule.texte: You cancelled the payment. No amount has been charged.

expire.texte: The payment session expired (15 minutes). No amount has been charged.

autre.texte: The payment was not completed. Go back to your application to see what happens next.

erreurs.court: Explain the reason in at least 10 characters: the applicant will read it.
erreurs.long: The reason exceeds 2000 characters: shorten it.

recevabilite.verification: I have opened and checked each attached document: legible, complete and in the applicant’s name.
recevabilite.verificationRequise: Tick this box after checking the documents.
recevabilite.pasEncoreTitre: The application cannot be declared admissible yet
recevabilite.pasEncoreFrais: The application fee has not been paid. You can declare it admissible as soon as the payment is confirmed.
recevabilite.pasEncorePieces: A mandatory document has no file. If the file cannot succeed, declare it inadmissible and give the reason.
recevabilite.indisponible: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

dialogue.explication: The application will be rejected and the applicant informed. This decision cannot be undone.
dialogue.aide: Say precisely what is wrong (illegible document, non-compliant document…). At least 10 characters.

decision.signataire: You decide as the signatory designated in the catalogue for this document: {signataire}.
decision.sensRequis: Choose a decision: approval or rejection.

options.rejetAide: The application is closed; the applicant reads the reason.

consequence.droits: The applicant will have to pay the duties ({montant}) before the document is issued.
consequence.sansDroits: This document has no duties to pay: the application will be ready for issuance at once.
consequence.rejet: The application will be rejected and the applicant will see the reason on it.

decision.motifRejet: Reason for rejection given to the applicant
decision.motifRejetAide: Explain precisely why the application is rejected. At least 10 characters.
decision.observationsAide: Conditions or remarks for the applicant.
decision.indisponible: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

confirmation.definitive: This decision is final: it cannot be changed.

audit.description: Every change recorded by the database, most recent first. The log can be neither changed nor erased.

recherche.exemple: Number, reference, email or application no.

periode.inversee: The end date is before the start date: correct the period.

audit.systemeDetail: System (TrésorPay notification, automatic task or migration)
audit.autres: {nombre, plural, one {and # other field} other {and # other fields}}

signer.signataire: You sign as the signatory designated in the catalogue: {signataire}.

etapes.etablir: The document “{document}” is produced as PDF/A with its number and QR code.
etapes.signer: It is signed electronically (PAdES) with your certificate.
etapes.archiver: It is archived and recorded in the register with its fingerprint.
etapes.remettre: The applicant receives it at once in their space.

signer.indisponible: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

confirmation.texte: The document “{document}” will be signed in your name and given to the applicant.
confirmation.definitive: Once issued, the document cannot be changed; only a revocation is possible.

revocation.explication: The document will show as “NOT VALID” on the public verification page, immediately. Revocation is final.
revocation.aide: Give the reason (fraud, clerical error, title withdrawn…). At least 10 characters.
revocation.indisponible: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
revocation.succes: Document {numero} is revoked: its verification shows “NOT VALID”.

aide.frais-attendus: For information: these applications can be reviewed once the fee is paid.
aide.a-decider: Admissible applications you sign: give your decision.
aide.a-signer: Duties paid: sign and issue the document.

vide.description: New files will appear here as soon as they await your action.

fait.delivree: Document {document} signed and issued for application {numero}.
